architectural_fidelity.reason: Same room architecture preserved: matching dark gray side walls, white ceiling with crown molding, window position on right, same ceiling height and viewing angle, recognizable stone feature wall replaced with Art Deco wallpaper treatment

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with clean floor base, no ghost outlines or remnants visible, only two accent chairs added as new staging

style_commitment.reason: Unmistakable Art Deco commitment: dramatic celestial/geometric gold-on-charcoal wallpaper with sunburst motifs, jewel-tone teal velvet chairs with Art Deco silhouettes, period-appropriate glamour and opulence clearly executed

editorial_density.reason: Severely understaged: only two chairs present, no coffee table, no layered textiles, no plants, no art, no surface styling, no rugs, no additional light sources beyond recessed—vastly below Architectural Digest editorial density standard shown in Collov examples

photorealism.reason: Coherent natural lighting from window, realistic wood flooring texture, proper chair material rendering, accurate shadow casting, wallpaper pattern has appropriate depth and metallic sheen without CGI feel

designer_preference_reason: While Cova demonstrates superior style conviction with authentic Art Deco drama, the room is woefully incomplete and unstylable for client presentation compared to Collov's fully-realized, market-ready staging.
what_cova_does_better: Dramatically superior style commitment with authentic Art Deco wallpaper and bold design choices
More distinctive and memorable aesthetic that showcases true period design vocabulary
Better preservation of original architectural character while transforming the space
what_collov_does_better: Complete room staging with full furniture layout, area rugs, and functional space planning
Editorial-level accessorizing with multiple textiles, art, plants, and styled surfaces
Market-ready presentation with appropriate density of decor elements
Multiple coordinated light sources and complete lighting scheme
specific_fixes_if_failing: Add substantial furniture: sofa or sectional, coffee table, side tables to create functional layout
Layer minimum 3-4 textiles: area rug, throw pillows, window treatments, decorative throws
Add wall art appropriate to Art Deco style: geometric mirrors, framed prints, or sculptural elements
Include plants/greenery and styled surface vignettes on tables
Add floor lamp, table lamps, or Art Deco chandelier to supplement recessed lighting
Style with Art Deco accessories: metallic objects, geometric sculptures, vintage barware
